IC1.IC1.1: Patients residing in the following clinical states will be considered:
IC1.IC1.2: A. Rising PSA: Patients with a history of localized disease who have undergone definitive radiation or surgery.
IC1.IC1.3: These patients must demonstrate progression of disease biochemically as outlined below.
IC1.IC1.4: Patients in this group may not have radiographically evident disease.

IC2.IC2.1: B. Non-castrate metastatic: Patients must present with radiographic evidence of metastatic disease at the time of diagnosis or after treatment for localized disease.
IC2.IC2.2: These patients must show newly detected disease or progressing disease in bone or in soft tissue.
IC2.IC2.7: Minimal % increase in range of values: 50%

IC.IC3: Diagnosis of prostate adenocarcinoma histologically confirmed at MSKCC.

IC4.IC4.1: Patient must have level of serum testosterone above the lower limit of normal.

IC6.IC6.1: Patients must have adequate organ function as defined by the following laboratory criteria:
IC6.IC6.4: Bilirubin <2.0 mg/dl or SGOT <3.0 X the upper limit of normal.
IC6.IC6.5: Creatinine <_1.6 mg/dl or creatinine clearance >_60 cc/min.

IC7.IC7.1: Prior hormonal therapy is allowed as:
IC7.IC7.2: 1. Neoadjuvant treatment prior to radiation therapy or radical prostatectomy, provided that the total duration of exposure does not exceed 10 months.
IC7.IC7.3: 2. One cycle of intermittent therapy up to a maximum exposure of 10 months.

IC.IC8: Patients must be at least 18 years of age.

IC9.IC9.1: Patients must have signed an informed consent document stating that they understand the investigational nature of the proposed treatment

EC1.EC1.1: Clinically significant cardiac disease (New York Heart Association Class III/IV),

EC3.EC3.1: Anticipated survival of less than 3 months.

EC5.EC5.1: Inability or unwillingness to comply with the treatment protocol, follow-up, or research tests.
